title: Ops lane takt sheet and rollforward log — Aug 2027 (sketch)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact takt-style ops sheet for the Aug 2027 release window. Designed to be used on the day-of as a single-pane-of-glass reference for who does what, when, and the exact smoke & rollback checks. Includes a short rollforward log for quick postmortem notes.

Status/Context:
- Drafted after the Aug 2 cutover dry run (notes from that run included below).
- Primary goal: reduce ambiguity during shift handoffs and make rollback decisions deterministic.
- Release components: API router changes (platform), serving-runtime kernel update, model catalog metadata migration, and console telemetry retention change. Tracked in REL-2148, INF-7890.

Week-at-a-glance (high-level cadence):
- Tue 2027-08-10: Preflight & final feature-freeze checks (08:00–12:00 PT)
- Wed 2027-08-11: Staged canary (region: us-west1, 10% traffic) 09:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2027-08-12: Scale to 50% across us-west/us-east 10:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 2027-08-13: Global traffic ramp and monitoring window 00:00–06:00 PT
- Post-release stabilization: Aug 13–20 daily check-ins 09:30 PT

Owner map (primary responsibilities):
- Release lead: Marcus Chen (overall go/no-go, comms)
- Traffic shepherd: Priya Sharma (traffic ramp, throttles)
- Observability: Liam O'Connor (dashboards, alerts, sampling)
- Rollback engineer: Diego Marquez (rollback runbook and execution)
- Database/metadata lead: Evelyn Park (catalog migration & DB migration checks)

Preflight checklist (to complete by Tue 12:00 PT):
- [ ] All PRs merged and green (GitHub PRs: see linked_artifacts)
- [ ] Integration smoke suite pass on staging (smoke-staging-2027-08-01)
- [ ] Canary image built and pinned to tag: release-2027-08-xx
- [ ] DB migration dry-run completed on staging and rollback script verified (migration ID: meta-202708-a)
- [ ] Ops runbook printed/pdf accessible to all on-call devices
- [ ] Paging rota confirmed for 72h post-release
- [ ] Contact list verified and escalation tree mapped in Slack snippet

Canary window (Wed 09:00–15:00 PT) — exact takt steps:
- 09:00: Start canary (10% traffic) — Traffic shepherd triggers routing rule INF_CANARY_10
- 09:00–09:30: Verify 5 golden requests (auth path, chat few-shot, embedding vector) — Observability marks success
- 09:30–10:30: Warmup interval — watch token-latency p50/p95 and CPU/GPU util; thresholds: p95 < 1.2x baseline, GPU util < 82%
- 10:30: Run KV cache sanity (prefix cache hitrate >= 65%)
- 11:00: Run longer tail tests (100 concurrent sessions) — if error rate > 0.5% -> HOLD
- 12:00: Preliminary go decision; if green, schedule 50% ramp at 13:00

50% ramp (Thu 10:00–16:00 PT) — criteria for progress:
- Rollout to 50% only if: error budget consumption < 5% in canary window, latency SLOs intact, no data-consistency alerts from metadata migration
- Traffic shepherd to increase in two 20% steps with 15m stable windows
- Auto-fallback policy: if p95 > 1.5x baseline for >10m or error rate spike >1% for >5m -> automatic revert to previous routing and trigger rollback play

Cutover communication script (short messages to post in #release-orchestra):
- Preflight done — all green, beginning canary at 09:00 PT (Marcus)
- Canary healthy at 10:45 — warming for scale (Priya)
- Scaling to 50% at 13:00 PT (system will step 20/30) (Marcus)
- Global ramp start at 00:00 PT Fri — watch channels and SLOs (Liam)

Smoke test matrix (must be run at each stage):
- Auth flow: login, token refresh, permission check (expected: <200ms p95)
- Generation quick path: 32-token prompt, deterministic seed — compare hash with golden (for non-deterministic bits allow fuzzy match)
- Embeddings: 10-vector batch — expected L2 diff within threshold vs baseline
- KV cache: prefix returns in <15ms
- Telemetry: events emitted for request id, model id, route id (sample rate 1%)

Rollback decision flow (succinct):
- Trigger conditions: sustained p95 >1.5x baseline (10m), error rate >1% (5m), or data corruption alert from metadata migration (any)
- Immediate action: flip traffic to previous stable routing, run migration rollback (if migration is implicated), notify execs+customers if >30m impact
- Communication once rollback committed: short note template in #release-orchestra + runbook entry (see rollback_runbook_v2)

Post-release stabilization checklist (first 72h):
- Daily telemetry snapshot (Liam) — check for drift in generation quality metrics
- Run periodic eval subset (10k prompts) nightly to detect subtle regressions
- Migration reconciliation: assert row counts and sample checksums for metadata tables
- Customer-impact triage: surface any tickets created during window, prioritize P1s for hotfixes

Rollforward log (live notes to capture during operations) — empty entries to fill on day-of:
- 2027-08-11 09:05 PT: Canary start. Note: initial p95 spike at +25% for first 2 minutes; normalized by 09:07. (author: Marcus)
- 2027-08-11 10:12 PT: Detected rare 502 pattern in edge router (edge-502-pattern-1). Mitigated by temporary traffic shift to us-east1. Action: investigate root cause (author: Priya)
- 2027-08-12 13:18 PT: Model catalog migration lagged 2m behind writer stream — restarted migration worker (meta-worker-03). Monitor for duplicates. (author: Evelyn)
- 2027-08-13 00:42 PT: Global ramp reached 100% — observed slight token-cost increase attributable to longer average responses; cost ops to follow up (author: Diego)

Release notes (draft for public/internal release):
- Title: Aug 2027 Platform Release — Serving runtime and catalog updates
- Short summary: This release updates the serving runtime with improved kernel selection (reduces p50 latency for medium-length prompts) and migrates model catalog metadata to a sharded schema to improve lookup throughput. Also includes a small telemetry retention change for Console analytics.
- Components changed: platform/router v2.1.0, serving-runtime v5.7.2, model-catalog migration meta-202708-a, console-telemetry v1.4.
- User impact: Minimal to no user-visible changes. Some customers may notice marginally faster median response times. No breaking API changes.
- Known issues: intermittent edge-502 pattern during brief routing reconfigurations (workaround: traffic shift); slight cost delta for long-generation sessions (investigation open INF-7890).
- Rollout status: global by 2027-08-13 01:00 PT; monitoring window until 2027-08-20.
- Follow-ups: cost regression analysis (owner: Diego), finalize migration idempotency checks (owner: Evelyn), update SDK changelog entry (owner: Marcus).

Open questions / TODO (notes to self):
- Do we want to include a forced cache flush at 50% ramp to normalize cold-cache effects? (Pros: avoids weird tail differences; Cons: spike risk) — bring up in preflight sync.
- Confirm customers on dedicated capacity who need explicit opt-out for the catalog migration. Contact: sales lead for dedicated customers list.
- Add permanent telemetry flag for canary experiments so we can backfill samples if needed.

Appendix: quick references and commands
- Rollback trigger CLI: infractl rollout revert --tag last-stable --scope all
- Migration rollback: psql -h meta-db --execute "SELECT migrate_rollback('meta-202708-a');" (run only after consulting DB lead)
- Smoke-run command: ./ops/smoke/run_smoke.sh --stage canary --tests quick|full
- Short links: REL-2148 (release epic), INF-7890 (cost investigation), PR#4123 (runtime kernel PR)

End of sketch.

-- Marcus (working draft; will convert to formal runbook and Confluence page once dry-run confirmed)
